comparator_revision: An independent unequal-pair probe after candidates 0001/0002 generation found CoreX GPU float64 subtraction returned zeros for [1,2] minus [1.125,2.25]. All correctness comparisons now use CPU float64 copies with identical tolerances, outside timed blocks. Prior v1/v2 reports are retained but their finite-correctness claims are superseded. Both candidates will be rerun; no baseline, input distribution, tolerance or timing code changed.
preflight_revision: Before any optimized candidate was generated, native_control failed 16/240 finite checks: native FP16 RMSNorm backward at input scale 0.001 produces infinities. The original contract/harness and data are archived. These cases remain in the matrix as CPU-verified native-compatibility tests, are not counted as finite-correctness passes, and cannot support low-precision training claims. All 224 finite-native cases remain mandatory with unchanged tolerances.
objective: Seek higher complete-step native Megatron throughput by adding TP=1 vocabulary cross-entropy fusion to candidate 0003 residual/RMSNorm, with unchanged model, baseline, input, tolerance, optimizer and timing.
baseline: Unmodified get_gpt_layer_local_spec(normalization='RMSNorm') plus get_bias_dropout_add(training=True, fused=False) at the pinned Megatron commit. Transformer Engine is not compatible in the present environment and is not the baseline.
target: Existing attention residual/RMSNorm plus candidate-instance compute_language_model_loss, only TP=1 and zero label smoothing. Native model remains unchanged.
candidate_api: Existing fused API byte-identical to 0003; additional cross_entropy(logits[S,B,V], target[S,B])->float32 loss[S,B], native max-shift loss and gradient semantics. Adapter owns fallback and TP guards.
allowed: Triton kernels supported by the observed CoreX build
shape-based dispatch with documented supported range
native fallback outside the supported contract
forbidden: change the baseline, verifier, tolerance, input distribution or measurement code
hard-code tensor values or RNG seed
change installed Megatron or vendor packages

checks: outputs and gradients against actual Megatron-selected RMSNorm and BDA
finite values when native is finite
exact residual sum and matching return dtypes
native-invalid cases checked separately on CPU for matching NaN and signed-infinity patterns, never counted as finite correctness

model.input: synthetic token batches, explicitly a representative benchmark, not production training

precision_contexts: bfloat16 autocast; log actual fused input/output dtypes

timing.operator: torch.cuda.Event; warmup=10, samples=15, launches_per_sample=30; alternate baseline/candidate order; report microseconds per call
timing.training: time.perf_counter around consecutive complete steps with GPU synchronization only at block boundaries; includes zero_grad, forward, loss, backward and optimizer.step; excludes data loading and checkpoint I/O
timing.speedup: baseline median time / candidate median time; never mix event latency with wall-clock throughput

promotion.memory_scope: temporary peak over two resident models; excludes single-model total memory claims
promotion.if_not_met: reject or retain as experimental; a complete loop may correctly end in rejection

evidence: CLI raw response, prompt and model ID
all raw timing samples and numeric errors

cross_entropy_contract.loss_math: log(sum(exp(logits-max))) - (targetlogit-max), or subtract zero for native out-of-range target mask
cross_entropy_contract.out_of_range_labels: NOT ignore_index; loss log(sumexp) and backward softmax*dloss
cross_entropy_contract.fp32_input_mutation: Native forward overwrites logits with softmax probabilities, and backward overwrites saved probabilities; preserve observable forward mutation. Low precision original logits are unchanged.
cross_entropy_contract.standalone_timing: none; native mutates inputs so no repeated-input CE microbenchmark

current_best_comparison: Separate contemporary processes, each paired to own native. Incremental ratio is (extended/native)/(current-best/native), an explicitly normalized independent comparison, not a three-arm same-process comparison.
new_scope_limit: TP=1 synthetic four-layer FP32 GPT, fixed local PyTorch backend. BF16 autocast and holdout are correctness/no-regression gates. No production, TP>1, multi-GPU, TE or low-precision training speedup claim unless independently evidenced.
